config.dialect.name: PostgreSqlDatabaseDialect
config.query: SELECT 'country_list' as type, json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'name', name, 'region', region)) as countries, NULL as books FROM countries UNION ALL SELECT 'book_list' as type, NULL as countries, json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'title', title, 'year', year, 'available', available, 'cost_price', cost_price, 'sale_price', sale_price)) as books FROM books;
